## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] A test covers the change (for a bug fix: one that failed before it)
- [ ] `public/display.js` is still ES5, and still understands what the server sends
- [ ] Touched the QR code? Made a test purchase with a real Swish app
- [ ] Changed a README? Changed both `README.md` and `README.en.md`
